### 1.b.5 Select ONLY active items to evaluate test performance

```{r}

# 1. READ METADATA & GET ACTIVE ITEM NAMES
item_metadata <- read_excel("~/Documents/R Studio Work/CSNT_Item_Usage_2026_All.xlsx")

active_items_list <- item_metadata %>%
  filter(Type == "Active") %>%
  pull(ItemID)

# 2. SUBSET MASTER DATA & ENFORCE VARIANCE FILTERING
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
id_var <- "fielddata"

# Extract active item columns from 2025 master dataset
active_matrix_raw <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(active_items_list))

# Calculate p-values (item means) to find zero-variance items
item_p_values <- colMeans(active_matrix_raw, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter criteria: Non-NaN AND 0 < p-value < 1 (removes zero-variance items)
valid_variance_cols <- !is.nan(item_p_values) & item_p_values > 0 & item_p_values < 1

# Subset item matrix to active + non-zero variance items only
clean_active_items2025 <- active_matrix_raw[, valid_variance_cols]

cat("Active items requested:", length(active_items_list), "\n")
cat("Active items retained (non-zero variance):", ncol(clean_active_items2025), "\n")
cat("Zero-variance active items dropped:", sum(!valid_variance_cols), "\n")

# 3. FILTER OUT PARTICIPANTS WITH NO RESPONSES ON ACTIVE ITEMS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logical mask for participants with AT LEAST ONE response across active items
valid_rows_active <- rowSums(!is.na(clean_active_items2025)) > 0

# Extract pure matrix passed to mirt() (no IDs, no demographic cols)
mirt_active_matrix <- clean_active_items2025[valid_rows_active, ]

cat("Participants analyzed in mirt():", nrow(mirt_active_matrix), "\n")

```

## 2. Adverse Impact

## Diversity Frequencies

```{r}
# 1. VERIFY DATA & DEFINE TARGET GRADES AND VARIABLES
# ===========================================================================
if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
  stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the workspace.")
}

target_grades <- c(
  "Administrative Officer",
  "Executive Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer",
  "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"
)

diversity_vars <- c(
  "gender",
  "disability",
  "application_form_applicant_type",
  "select_your_ethnicity",
  "what_is_your_sexual_orientation",
  "select_your_ethnic_group",
  "select_your_current_age_group",
  "what_is_your_religion_or_belief",
  "were_you_eligible_for_free_school_meals_at_any_point"
)

# Identify grade column name safely
col_grade <- intersect(
  c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), 
  colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025)
)[1]

# Verify all diversity variables exist in the dataset
missing_vars <- setdiff(diversity_vars, colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))
if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  warning("The following variables were not found in the dataset and will be skipped: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))
  diversity_vars <- intersect(diversity_vars, colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))
}

# 2. COMPUTE FREQUENCIES FOR EACH GRADE & DIVERSITY VARIABLE
# ===========================================================================
grade_sheet_mapping <- list(
  "Administrative Officer"   = "Admin Officer",
  "Executive Officer"        = "Exec Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",
  "Grade 7"                  = "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (full_grade in target_grades) {
  sheet_name <- grade_sheet_mapping[[full_grade]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  
  # Filter data for current grade
  grade_df <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
    filter(.data[[col_grade]] == full_grade)
  
  start_row <- 1
  
  for (var_name in diversity_vars) {
    # Compute frequency table including missing/NA/NULL values explicitly
    var_freq <- grade_df %>%
      mutate(Category = as.character(.data[[var_name]])) %>%
      mutate(Category = ifelse(is.na(Category) | Category == "" | Category == "NULL", "Missing / Not Stated", Category)) %>%
      group_by(Category) %>%
      summarise(Frequency = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(
        Percentage = round(Frequency / sum(Frequency) * 100, 2),
        Variable   = var_name
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Frequency)) %>%
      select(Variable, Category, Frequency, Percentage)
    
    # Write header title for this variable section
    writeData(wb, sheet_name, paste0("Variable: ", var_name), startRow = start_row, startCol = 1)
    
    # Write data frame table
    writeData(wb, sheet_name, var_freq, startRow = start_row + 1, startCol = 1)
    
    # Add spacing between variable tables
    start_row <- start_row + nrow(var_freq) + 4
  }
}

# 3. SAVE WORKBOOK
# ===========================================================================
excel_filename <- "CSNT_Diversity_Group_Frequencies_by_Grade2025.xlsx"
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_filename, overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nWorkbook successfully saved with separate sheets for each grade:", excel_filename, "\n")


# 4. PREVIEW FREQUENCY TABLE IN QUARTO REPORT (E.G., ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER)
# ===========================================================================
cat("### Sample Frequency Preview: Administrative Officer (Gender & Disability)\n")
preview_df <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  filter(.data[[col_grade]] == "Administrative Officer") %>%
  select(gender, disability) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Category") %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(is.na(Category) | Category == "" | Category == "NULL", "Missing / Not Stated", Category)) %>%
  group_by(Variable, Category) %>%
  summarise(Frequency = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Frequency / sum(Frequency) * 100, 2))

kable(preview_df, caption = "Frequency Breakdown Preview for Administrative Officer")
```

### A. GENDER

```{r}
# 1. VERIFY DATA & PREPARE DATASET
# ================================================================
if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
  stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the environment.")
}

target_grades <- c(
  "Administrative Officer",
  "Executive Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer",
  "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"
)

# Detect grade column name safely
col_grade <- intersect(c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]

# Filter CSNT_Complete_Diversity_Test_Merged for target grades and Man vs. Woman only
df_ai_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  filter(.data[[col_grade]] %in% target_grades) %>%
  filter(gender %in% c("Man", "Woman")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NRTPercentileScore), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
  mutate(
    Grade  = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
    Gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Man", "Woman")),
    Percentile = round(NRTPercentileScore) # Ensure clean integer percentiles 1..99
  )


# 2. CALCULATE ADVERSE IMPACT RATIO FOR EACH PERCENTILE (1 TO 99) BY GRADE
# ================================================================
# Step A: Get total candidates per grade x gender (for denominators)
total_counts_per_grade <- df_ai_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Grand_Total_Man   = sum(Gender == "Man"),
    Grand_Total_Woman = sum(Gender == "Woman"),
    .groups           = "drop"
  )

# Step B: Count candidates at each exact percentile level (1 to 99)
pct_counts <- df_ai_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade, Percentile) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_Man         = sum(Gender == "Man"),
    Count_Woman       = sum(Gender == "Woman"),
    Mean_Theta_Man    = mean(NRTtheta[Gender == "Man"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Theta_Woman  = mean(NRTtheta[Gender == "Woman"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta_Man      = sd(NRTtheta[Gender == "Man"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta_Woman    = sd(NRTtheta[Gender == "Woman"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups           = "drop"
  )

# Step C: Compute Cumulative Selection Rates & Adverse Impact Ratios (>= Percentile)
percentile_ai_summary <- pct_counts %>%
  left_join(total_counts_per_grade, by = "Grade") %>%
  arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Sort descending to compute reverse cumulative sums
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  mutate(
    # Cumulative candidates reaching or exceeding percentile P
    Cum_Passed_Man   = cumsum(Count_Man),
    Cum_Passed_Woman = cumsum(Count_Woman),
    
    # Cumulative Selection Rates
    Cum_Rate_Man     = Cum_Passed_Man / Grand_Total_Man,
    Cum_Rate_Woman   = Cum_Passed_Woman / Grand_Total_Woman,
    
    # Adverse Impact Ratio at this percentile cutoff (Woman / Man)
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_Woman / ifelse(Cum_Rate_Man == 0, NA, Cum_Rate_Man), 4),
    
    # 4/5ths Rule Status at this percentile
    Status_4_5ths = ifelse(Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)", "PASS (>= 0.80)"),
    
    # Effect Size (Cohen's d) for theta at this percentile level
    Pooled_SD_Pct = sqrt((replace_na(SD_Theta_Man, 0)^2 + replace_na(SD_Theta_Woman, 0)^2) / 2),
    Effect_Size_d = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_Woman - Mean_Theta_Man) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>% # Re-sort back in standard 1..99 order
  select(
    Grade, Percentile, Count_Man, Count_Woman, 
    Cum_Passed_Man, Cum_Passed_Woman, 
    Cum_Rate_Man, Cum_Rate_Woman, 
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
    Mean_Theta_Man, Mean_Theta_Woman, Effect_Size_d
  )



# 3. DISPLAY PREVIEW TABLES IN QUARTO REPORT
# ================================================================

cat("\n### Percentile-Level Adverse Impact Preview (Administrative Officer: Percentiles 20 to 35)\n")
ao_preview <- percentile_ai_summary %>% 
  filter(Grade == "Administrative Officer", Percentile >= 20, Percentile <= 35)
kable(ao_preview, caption = "Per-Percentile Counts, Cumulative Pass Rates, and AI Ratios")


# 4. EXPORT TO WORKBOOK (.XLSX)
# ================================================================
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Add sheets
addWorksheet(wb, "Percentile Adverse Impact")

# Write data
writeData(wb, "Percentile Adverse Impact", percentile_ai_summary)

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, "CSNT_Gender_Adverse_Impact_by_Percentile.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nAnalysis saved to Excel file: CSNT_Gender_Adverse_Impact_by_Percentile.xlsx\n")
```

    ### B. Disability

    ```{r}
    # 1. VERIFY DATA & DETECT COLUMNS SAFELY
    # ==============================================================================
    if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
      stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the workspace.")
    }

    target_grades <- c(
      "Administrative Officer",
      "Executive Officer",
      "Higher Executive Officer",
      "Senior Executive Officer",
      "Grade 7",
      "Grade 6"
    )

    # Detect column names safely
    col_grade <- intersect(c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]
    col_disab <- intersect(c("disability", "Disability", "disability_status", "disability_clean"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]

    if (is.na(col_disab)) {
      stop("Could not detect a disability column! Available columns: ", paste(colnames(CSNT_Complete_Diversity_Test_Merged), collapse = ", "))
    }

    # Filter for target grades, disability == "No" or "Yes" only
    df_disab_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
      filter(.data[[col_grade]] %in% target_grades) %>%
      filter(.data[[col_disab]] %in% c("No", "Yes")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(NRTPercentileScore), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
      mutate(
        Grade      = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
        Disability = factor(.data[[col_disab]], levels = c("No", "Yes")),
        Percentile = round(NRTPercentileScore) # Clean integer percentiles 1..99
      )

    # ==============================================================================
    # 2. OVERALL GRADE SUMMARY AT DEFAULT 29th PERCENTILE CUTOFF
    # ==============================================================================
    summary_ai_disab <- df_disab_prep %>%
      mutate(Pass = ifelse(NRTPercentileScore >= 29, 1, 0)) %>%
      group_by(Grade, Disability) %>%
      summarise(
        Total_N         = n(),
        Total_Passed    = sum(Pass),
        Pass_Rate       = mean(Pass),
        Mean_Theta      = mean(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD_Theta        = sd(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups         = "drop"
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = Grade,
        names_from = Disability,
        values_from = c(Total_N, Total_Passed, Pass_Rate, Mean_Theta, SD_Theta)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Impact_Ratio   = round(Pass_Rate_Yes / Pass_Rate_No, 4),
        Adverse_Impact = ifelse(Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "YES (Adverse Impact)", "NO (Passes 4/5ths)"),
        Pooled_SD      = sqrt(((Total_N_No - 1)*SD_Theta_No^2 + (Total_N_Yes - 1)*SD_Theta_Yes^2) / (Total_N_No + Total_N_Yes - 2)),
        Cohens_d_Theta = round((Mean_Theta_Yes - Mean_Theta_No) / Pooled_SD, 4)
      )

    # ==============================================================================
    # 3. DETAILED PERCENTILE BREAKDOWN (1 TO 99) WITH CUMULATIVE AI RATIOS
    # ==============================================================================
    total_counts_per_grade <- df_disab_prep %>%
      group_by(Grade) %>%
      summarise(
        Grand_Total_No  = sum(Disability == "No"),
        Grand_Total_Yes = sum(Disability == "Yes"),
        .groups          = "drop"
      )

    pct_counts_disab <- df_disab_prep %>%
      group_by(Grade, Percentile) %>%
      summarise(
        Count_No        = sum(Disability == "No"),
        Count_Yes       = sum(Disability == "Yes"),
        Mean_Theta_No   = mean(NRTtheta[Disability == "No"], na.rm = TRUE),
        Mean_Theta_Yes  = mean(NRTtheta[Disability == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
        SD_Theta_No     = sd(NRTtheta[Disability == "No"], na.rm = TRUE),
        SD_Theta_Yes    = sd(NRTtheta[Disability == "Yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups         = "drop"
      )

    percentile_disab_summary <- pct_counts_disab %>%
      left_join(total_counts_per_grade, by = "Grade") %>%
      arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Sort descending for reverse cumulative sum
      group_by(Grade) %>%
      mutate(
        # Cumulative candidates reaching/exceeding percentile P
        Cum_Passed_No   = cumsum(Count_No),
        Cum_Passed_Yes  = cumsum(Count_Yes),
        
        # Cumulative Selection Rates
        Cum_Rate_No     = Cum_Passed_No / Grand_Total_No,
        Cum_Rate_Yes    = Cum_Passed_Yes / Grand_Total_Yes,
        
        # Adverse Impact Ratio (Yes / No)
        Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_Yes / ifelse(Cum_Rate_No == 0, NA, Cum_Rate_No), 4),
        Status_4_5ths        = ifelse(Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)", "PASS (>= 0.80)"),
        
        # Effect Size (Cohen's d) for theta at each percentile
        Pooled_SD_Pct        = sqrt((replace_na(SD_Theta_No, 0)^2 + replace_na(SD_Theta_Yes, 0)^2) / 2),
        Effect_Size_d        = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_Yes - Mean_Theta_No) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>% # Return to standard 1..99 order
      select(
        Grade, Percentile, Count_No, Count_Yes, 
        Cum_Passed_No, Cum_Passed_Yes, 
        Cum_Rate_No, Cum_Rate_Yes, 
        Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
        Mean_Theta_No, Mean_Theta_Yes, Effect_Size_d
      )

    # ==============================================================================
    # 4. EXPORT TO MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK (SEPARATE SHEET PER GRADE)
    # ==============================================================================
    wb <- createWorkbook()

    # Add Summary Tab
    addWorksheet(wb, "Disability AI Summary")
    writeData(wb, "Disability AI Summary", summary_ai_disab)

    # Create a separate sheet for each grade
    grade_sheet_mapping <- list(
      "Administrative Officer"   = "Admin Officer",
      "Executive Officer"        = "Exec Officer",
      "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
      "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",
      "Grade 7"                  = "Grade 7",
      "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
    )

    for (full_grade in target_grades) {
      sheet_name <- grade_sheet_mapping[[full_grade]]
      addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
      
      # Filter data for this grade only
      grade_data <- percentile_disab_summary %>% 
        filter(Grade == full_grade) %>%
        select(-Grade)
      
      writeData(wb, sheet_name, grade_data)
    }

    # Save workbook
    saveWorkbook(wb, "CSNT_Disability_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
    cat("\nWorkbook saved successfully with separate sheets for each grade: CSNT_Disability_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx\n")

    # ==============================================================================
    # 5. DISPLAY PREVIEW TABLES IN QUARTO REPORT
    # ==============================================================================
    cat("### Disability Adverse Impact Summary (Cutoff >= 29th Percentile)\n")
    kable(
      summary_ai_disab %>% select(Grade, Total_N_No, Total_N_Yes, Pass_Rate_No, Pass_Rate_Yes, Impact_Ratio, Adverse_Impact, Cohens_d_Theta),
      caption = "Overall Disability AI Summary (Yes vs No)"
    )
    ```

    7.C. APPLICANT TYPE

```{r}
# 1. VERIFY DATA & SAFE COLUMN EXTRACTION
# ===========================================================================

if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
  stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the workspace.")
}

target_grades <- c(
  "Administrative Officer",
  "Executive Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer",
  "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"
)

# Detect column names safely
col_grade <- intersect(c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]
col_app_type <- intersect(c("application_form_applicant_type", "applicant_type", "Applicant_Type"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]

if (is.na(col_app_type)) {
  stop("Could not find applicant type column in CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025!")
}

# Safely extract and classify into 'External' vs 'Internal / OGD'
df_app_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  filter(.data[[col_grade]] %in% target_grades) %>%
  mutate(app_type_clean = as.character(.data[[col_app_type]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(app_type_clean) & app_type_clean != "NULL") %>%
  mutate(
    App_Group = case_when(
      grepl("^External", app_type_clean, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "External",
      grepl("^(Internal|OGD)", app_type_clean, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Internal / OGD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(App_Group)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NRTPercentileScore), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
  mutate(
    Grade      = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
    App_Group  = factor(App_Group, levels = c("Internal / OGD", "External")), # Benchmark: Internal/OGD
    Percentile = round(NRTPercentileScore) # Integer percentiles 1..99
  )


# 2. PERCENTILE BREAKDOWN (1 TO 99) WITH CUMULATIVE AI RATIOS
# ==============================================================================
total_counts_app <- df_app_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Grand_Total_Internal = sum(App_Group == "Internal / OGD"),
    Grand_Total_External = sum(App_Group == "External"),
    .groups              = "drop"
  )

pct_counts_app <- df_app_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade, Percentile) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_Internal       = sum(App_Group == "Internal / OGD"),
    Count_External       = sum(App_Group == "External"),
    Mean_Theta_Internal  = mean(NRTtheta[App_Group == "Internal / OGD"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Theta_External  = mean(NRTtheta[App_Group == "External"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta_Internal    = sd(NRTtheta[App_Group == "Internal / OGD"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta_External    = sd(NRTtheta[App_Group == "External"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups              = "drop"
  )

percentile_app_summary <- pct_counts_app %>%
  left_join(total_counts_app, by = "Grade") %>%
  arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Sort descending for reverse cumulative sums
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  mutate(
    # Cumulative candidates reaching/exceeding percentile P
    Cum_Passed_Internal = cumsum(Count_Internal),
    Cum_Passed_External = cumsum(Count_External),
    
    # Cumulative Selection Rates
    Cum_Rate_Internal   = Cum_Passed_Internal / Grand_Total_Internal,
    Cum_Rate_External   = Cum_Passed_External / Grand_Total_External,
    
    # Adverse Impact Ratio (External / Internal)
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_External / ifelse(Cum_Rate_Internal == 0, NA, Cum_Rate_Internal), 4),
    Status_4_5ths        = ifelse(Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)", "PASS (>= 0.80)"),
    
    # Effect Size (Cohen's d) for theta at each percentile
    Pooled_SD_Pct        = sqrt((replace_na(SD_Theta_Internal, 0)^2 + replace_na(SD_Theta_External, 0)^2) / 2),
    Effect_Size_d        = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_External - Mean_Theta_Internal) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>% # Return to standard 1..99 order
  select(
    Grade, Percentile, Count_Internal, Count_External, 
    Cum_Passed_Internal, Cum_Passed_External, 
    Cum_Rate_Internal, Cum_Rate_External, 
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
    Mean_Theta_Internal, Mean_Theta_External, Effect_Size_d
  )


# 3. EXPORT TO MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK (SEPARATE SHEET PER GRADE)
# ===========================================================================

wb <- createWorkbook()

# Create a separate sheet for each grade
grade_sheet_mapping <- list(
  "Administrative Officer"   = "Admin Officer",
  "Executive Officer"        = "Exec Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",
  "Grade 7"                  = "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
)

for (full_grade in target_grades) {
  sheet_name <- grade_sheet_mapping[[full_grade]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  
  grade_data <- percentile_app_summary %>% 
    filter(Grade == full_grade) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-Grade)
  
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, grade_data)
}

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, "CSNT_Applicant_Type_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nWorkbook saved successfully: CSNT_Applicant_Type_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx\n")


# 4. DISPLAY PREVIEW TABLE IN QUARTO REPORT
# ===========================================================================
cat("### Percentile Breakdown Preview (Administrative Officer: Percentiles 1–15)\n")
kable(
  head(percentile_app_summary %>% filter(Grade == "Administrative Officer"), 15),
  caption = "Percentile Breakdown (1–99) Preview for Administrative Officer"
)
```

### D. Ethnicity

1.  First get the frequencies of all the diversity groups. group them into White, which is Majority and Other, which is all the other ethnic groups.

```{r}
# 1. VERIFY DATA & SAFELY PREPARE ETHNICITY GROUPS
# ================================================================
if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
  stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the workspace.")
}

target_grades <- c(
  "Administrative Officer",
  "Executive Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer",
  "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"
)

# Target minority ethnicities
minority_ethnicities <- c(
  "Asian / Asian British",
  "Black / African / Caribbean / Black British",
  "Mixed / multiple ethnic groups",
  "Other ethnic group"
)

# Safely identify column names
col_grade <- intersect(c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]
col_eth   <- intersect(c("select_your_ethnic_group", "select_your ethnicity", "ethnicity", "Ethnicity", "select_your_ethnicity"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]

if (is.na(col_eth)) {
  stop("Could not find ethnicity column in CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025!")
}

# Recode ethnicity into 'White' vs 'Other' (Excludes NAs and 'Prefer not to disclose')
df_eth_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  filter(.data[[col_grade]] %in% target_grades) %>%
  mutate(eth_raw = trimws(as.character(.data[[col_eth]]))) %>%
  # Filter out missing, NULL, and explicit opt-out responses
  filter(!is.na(eth_raw) & eth_raw != "NULL" & eth_raw != "" & eth_raw != "Prefer not to disclose") %>%
  mutate(
    Ethnicity_Group = case_when(
      eth_raw == "White" ~ "White",
      eth_raw %in% minority_ethnicities ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ethnicity_Group)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NRTPercentileScore), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
  mutate(
    Grade           = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
    Ethnicity_Group = factor(Ethnicity_Group, levels = c("White", "Other")), # White as Benchmark
    Percentile      = round(NRTPercentileScore) # Integer percentiles 1..99
  )


# 2. FULL PERCENTILE BREAKDOWN (1 TO 99) FOR EACH GRADE
# ================================================================
total_counts_eth <- df_eth_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Grand_Total_White = sum(Ethnicity_Group == "White"),
    Grand_Total_Other = sum(Ethnicity_Group == "Other"),
    .groups           = "drop"
  )

# Ensure grid covers all percentiles (1 to 99) for every grade
complete_grid <- expand.grid(
  Grade = factor(target_grades, levels = target_grades),
  Percentile = 1:99
)

pct_counts_eth <- df_eth_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade, Percentile) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_White      = sum(Ethnicity_Group == "White"),
    Count_Other      = sum(Ethnicity_Group == "Other"),
    Mean_Theta_White = mean(NRTtheta[Ethnicity_Group == "White"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Theta_Other = mean(NRTtheta[Ethnicity_Group == "Other"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta_White   = sd(NRTtheta[Ethnicity_Group == "White"], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta_Other   = sd(NRTtheta[Ethnicity_Group == "Other"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups          = "drop"
  )

percentile_eth_summary <- complete_grid %>%
  left_join(pct_counts_eth, by = c("Grade", "Percentile")) %>%
  mutate(
    Count_White = replace_na(Count_White, 0),
    Count_Other = replace_na(Count_Other, 0)
  ) %>%
  left_join(total_counts_eth, by = "Grade") %>%
  arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Reverse sort to accumulate candidates from top (99) to bottom (1)
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  mutate(
    # Cumulative candidates reaching or exceeding Percentile P
    Cum_Passed_White = cumsum(Count_White),
    Cum_Passed_Other = cumsum(Count_Other),
    
    # Cumulative Selection Rates
    Cum_Rate_White   = Cum_Passed_White / Grand_Total_White,
    Cum_Rate_Other   = Cum_Passed_Other / Grand_Total_Other,
    
    # Adverse Impact Ratio (Other / White)
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_Other / ifelse(Cum_Rate_White == 0, NA, Cum_Rate_White), 4),
    Status_4_5ths        = case_when(
      is.na(Adverse_Impact_Ratio) ~ "NO DATA",
      Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80 ~ "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)",
      TRUE ~ "PASS (>= 0.80)"
    ),
    
    # Effect Size (Cohen's d) for theta at each percentile
    Pooled_SD_Pct        = sqrt((replace_na(SD_Theta_White, 0)^2 + replace_na(SD_Theta_Other, 0)^2) / 2),
    Effect_Size_d        = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_Other - Mean_Theta_White) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>% # Sort back to standard 1..99 order
  select(
    Grade, Percentile, Count_White, Count_Other, 
    Cum_Passed_White, Cum_Passed_Other, 
    Cum_Rate_White, Cum_Rate_Other, 
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
    Mean_Theta_White, Mean_Theta_Other, Effect_Size_d
  )

# 3. EXPORT TO MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK (SEPARATE SHEET PER GRADE)
# ===========================================================================
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet mapping for clean tab names
grade_sheet_mapping <- list(
  "Administrative Officer"   = "Admin Officer",
  "Executive Officer"        = "Exec Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",
  "Grade 7"                  = "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
)

# Export each grade's full 1-99 percentile matrix into a separate Excel tab
for (full_grade in target_grades) {
  sheet_name <- grade_sheet_mapping[[full_grade]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  
  grade_data <- percentile_eth_summary %>% 
    filter(Grade == full_grade) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    select(-Grade)
  
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, grade_data)
}

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, "CSNT_Ethnicity_Adverse_Impact2025_All_Percentiles.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nWorkbook saved successfully: CSNT_Ethnicity_Adverse_Impact2025_All_Percentiles.xlsx\n")


# 4. DISPLAY PREVIEW IN QUARTO REPORT
# ===========================================================================
cat("### Percentile Adverse Impact Breakdown (Percentiles 1 to 99)\n")

# Display first 10 rows per grade as a preview in the rendered doc
kable(

  caption = "Preview: First 10 Percentiles per Grade (Full 1-99 breakdown available in exported Excel file)"
```

### E. Sexual Orientation

'what_is_your_sexual_orientation'. Majority group is 'Heterosexual or straight' 'Other' will be combination of other groups. Inspect Frequencies first. Merge groups into one excluding 'Prefer not to disclose'

Then comes AI and ES analysis for all grades

```{r}
# 1. VERIFY DATA & IDENTIFY COLUMNS
# ===========================================================================

if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
  stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the workspace.")
}

target_grades <- c(
  "Administrative Officer",
  "Executive Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer",
  "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"
)

col_grade <- intersect(c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]
col_so    <- intersect(c("what_is_your_sexual_orientation", "sexual_orientation", "Sexual_Orientation"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]

if (is.na(col_so)) {
  stop("Could not find 'what_is_your_sexual_orientation' column in CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025!")
}

# 2. STRICT DATA CLEANING & EXCLUSIONS
# ===========================================================================
df_so_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  filter(.data[[col_grade]] %in% target_grades) %>%
  mutate(
    so_raw     = as.character(.data[[col_so]]),
    NRTtheta   = as.numeric(as.character(NRTtheta)),           # Force numeric type
    Percentile = round(as.numeric(as.character(NRTPercentileScore))) # Force numeric type
  ) %>%
  
  # Exclude NAs, NULLs, blanks, and "Prefer not to disclose"
  filter(!is.na(so_raw) & !so_raw %in% c("NULL", "", "NA")) %>%
  filter(!grepl("prefer not to|disclose|refused", so_raw, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Percentile), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
  
  # Binary Grouping
  mutate(
    SO_Group = case_when(
      grepl("^Heterosexual", so_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Heterosexual or straight",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Grade    = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
    SO_Group = factor(SO_Group, levels = c("Heterosexual or straight", "Other"))
  )


# 3. OVERALL GRADE SUMMARY AT 29th PERCENTILE CUTOFF
# ===========================================================================
summary_ai_so <- df_so_prep %>%
  mutate(Pass = ifelse(Percentile >= 29, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Grade, SO_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_N         = n(),
    Total_Passed    = sum(Pass),
    Pass_Rate       = mean(Pass),
    Mean_Theta      = mean(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Theta        = sd(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Grade,
    names_from = SO_Group,
    values_from = c(Total_N, Total_Passed, Pass_Rate, Mean_Theta, SD_Theta)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Impact_Ratio   = round(Pass_Rate_Other / `Pass_Rate_Heterosexual or straight`, 4),
    Adverse_Impact = ifelse(Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "YES (Adverse Impact)", "NO (Passes 4/5ths)"),
    
    # Safe Pooled SD & Cohen's d (Prevents / 0)
    Pooled_SD      = sqrt(((`Total_N_Heterosexual or straight` - 1) * `SD_Theta_Heterosexual or straight`^2 + (Total_N_Other - 1) * SD_Theta_Other^2) / (`Total_N_Heterosexual or straight` + Total_N_Other - 2)),
    Cohens_d_Theta = ifelse(Pooled_SD > 0, round((Mean_Theta_Other - `Mean_Theta_Heterosexual or straight`) / Pooled_SD, 4), 0)
  )

 
# 4. PERCENTILE BREAKDOWN (1 TO 99) WITH SAFE EFFECT SIZE DIVISION
# =========================================================================== 
total_counts_so <- df_so_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  summarise(
    Grand_Total_Hetero = sum(SO_Group == "Heterosexual or straight"),
    Grand_Total_Other  = sum(SO_Group == "Other"),
    .groups            = "drop"
  )

pct_counts_so <- df_so_prep %>%
  group_by(Grade, Percentile) %>%
  summarise(
    Count_Hetero       = sum(SO_Group == "Heterosexual or straight"),
    Count_Other        = sum(SO_Group == "Other"),
    Mean_Theta_Hetero  = round(mean(NRTtheta[SO_Group == "Heterosexual or straight"], na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Mean_Theta_Other   = round(mean(NRTtheta[SO_Group == "Other"], na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    SD_Theta_Hetero    = replace_na(sd(NRTtheta[SO_Group == "Heterosexual or straight"], na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    SD_Theta_Other     = replace_na(sd(NRTtheta[SO_Group == "Other"], na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    .groups            = "drop"
  )

percentile_so_summary <- pct_counts_so %>%
  left_join(total_counts_so, by = "Grade") %>%
  arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Sort descending for reverse cumulative sums
  group_by(Grade) %>%
  mutate(
    Cum_Passed_Hetero = cumsum(Count_Hetero),
    Cum_Passed_Other  = cumsum(Count_Other),
    
    Cum_Rate_Hetero   = Cum_Passed_Hetero / Grand_Total_Hetero,
    Cum_Rate_Other    = Cum_Passed_Other / Grand_Total_Other,
    
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_Other / ifelse(Cum_Rate_Hetero == 0, 1, Cum_Rate_Hetero), 4),
    Status_4_5ths        = ifelse(Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)", "PASS (>= 0.80)"),
    
    # Standardized Pooled SD
    Pooled_SD_Pct        = sqrt((SD_Theta_Hetero^2 + SD_Theta_Other^2) / 2),
    
    # Division-by-Zero Guard for Effect Size
    Effect_Size_d        = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_Other - Mean_Theta_Hetero) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>%
  select(
    Grade, Percentile, Count_Hetero, Count_Other, 
    Cum_Passed_Hetero, Cum_Passed_Other, 
    Cum_Rate_Hetero, Cum_Rate_Other, 
    Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
    Mean_Theta_Hetero, Mean_Theta_Other, Effect_Size_d
  )
 
# 5. EXPORT TO MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK
# =========================================================================== 
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Summary
addWorksheet(wb, "Sexual Orientation AI Summary")
writeData(wb, "Sexual Orientation AI Summary", summary_ai_so)

# Sheets 2-7: Grade-Specific Breakdown
grade_sheet_mapping <- list(
  "Administrative Officer"   = "Admin Officer",
  "Executive Officer"        = "Exec Officer",
  "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
  "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",
  "Grade 7"                  = "Grade 7",
  "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
)

for (full_grade in target_grades) {
  sheet_name <- grade_sheet_mapping[[full_grade]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  
  grade_data <- percentile_so_summary %>% 
    filter(Grade == full_grade) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-Grade)
  
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, grade_data)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "CSNT_Sexual_Orientation_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
cat("\nWorkbook saved cleanly: CSNT_Sexual_Orientation_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx\n")
```

### F. Age

1.  Identify age groups

```{r}
# Safe frequency inspection for select_your_current_age_group
age_freqs <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
  mutate(age_raw = as.character(.data[["select_your_current_age_group"]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_raw) & !age_raw %in% c("NULL", "", "NA")) %>%
  mutate(
    Age_Group = case_when(
      grepl("^(40|45|50|55|60|65|70|75|80|40-44|45-49|50-54|55-59|60-64|65\\+)", age_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "40 and Higher",
      grepl("^(16|20|25|30|35|16-24|25-29|30-34|35-39|Under 40)", age_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Under 40",
      TRUE ~ "Under 40" # Default allocation for remaining lower age bands
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(age_raw, Age_Group) %>%
  summarise(Frequency = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Frequency / sum(Frequency) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(Age_Group, desc(Frequency))

kable(age_freqs, caption = "Frequency Counts and Mapping for 'select_your_current_age_group'")
```

2.  get the adverse impact ratios

    ```{r}
    # 1. VERIFY DATA & IDENTIFY COLUMNS
    # =======================================================================
    if (!exists("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025")) {
      stop("CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 is not present in the workspace.")
    }

    target_grades <- c(
      "Administrative Officer",
      "Executive Officer",
      "Higher Executive Officer",
      "Senior Executive Officer",
      "Grade 7",
      "Grade 6"
    )

    col_grade <- intersect(c("job_grade_clean", "job_grade.x", "job_grade", "Job_Grade", "Grade"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]
    col_age   <- intersect(c("select_your_current_age_group", "age_group", "Age_Group", "age"), colnames(CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025))[1]

    if (is.na(col_age)) {
      stop("Could not find 'select_your_current_age_group' column in CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025!")
    }
     
    # 2. APPLY EXCLUSIONS & CATEGORIZE AGE GROUPS
    # ======================================================================= 
    df_age_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>%
      filter(.data[[col_grade]] %in% target_grades) %>%
      mutate(
        age_raw    = as.character(.data[[col_age]]),
        NRTtheta   = as.numeric(as.character(NRTtheta)),
        Percentile = round(as.numeric(as.character(NRTPercentileScore)))
      ) %>%
      
      # Exclude NAs, NULLs, and empty strings
      filter(!is.na(age_raw) & !age_raw %in% c("NULL", "", "NA")) %>%
      filter(!grepl("prefer not to|disclose|refused", age_raw, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Percentile), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
      
      # Grouping Logic: '40 and Higher' vs 'Under 40'
      mutate(
        Age_Group = case_when(
          grepl("^(40|45|50|55|60|65|70|75|80|40-44|45-49|50-54|55-59|60-64|65\\+)", age_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "40 and Higher",
          TRUE ~ "Under 40"
        ),
        Grade     = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
        Age_Group = factor(Age_Group, levels = c("Under 40", "40 and Higher")) # Under 40 as Benchmark
      )
     
    # 3. OVERALL GRADE SUMMARY AT DEFAULT 29th PERCENTILE CUTOFF
    # =======================================================================
    summary_ai_age <- df_age_prep %>%
      mutate(Pass = ifelse(Percentile >= 29, 1, 0)) %>%
      group_by(Grade, Age_Group) %>%
      summarise(
        Total_N         = n(),
        Total_Passed    = sum(Pass),
        Pass_Rate       = mean(Pass),
        Mean_Theta      = mean(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD_Theta        = sd(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups         = "drop"
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = Grade,
        names_from = Age_Group,
        values_from = c(Total_N, Total_Passed, Pass_Rate, Mean_Theta, SD_Theta)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        # Adverse Impact Ratio: (40 and Higher) / (Under 40)
        Impact_Ratio   = round(`Pass_Rate_40 and Higher` / `Pass_Rate_Under 40`, 4),
        Adverse_Impact = ifelse(Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "YES (Adverse Impact)", "NO (Passes 4/5ths)"),
        
        # Cohen's d Effect Size for Theta
        Pooled_SD      = sqrt(((`Total_N_Under 40` - 1) * `SD_Theta_Under 40`^2 + (`Total_N_40 and Higher` - 1) * `SD_Theta_40 and Higher`^2) / (`Total_N_Under 40` + `Total_N_40 and Higher` - 2)),
        Cohens_d_Theta = ifelse(Pooled_SD > 0, round((`Mean_Theta_40 and Higher` - `Mean_Theta_Under 40`) / Pooled_SD, 4), 0)
      )
     
    # 4. PERCENTILE BREAKDOWN (1 TO 99) WITH CUMULATIVE AI RATIOS & EFFECT SIZES
    # =======================================================================
    total_counts_age <- df_age_prep %>%
      group_by(Grade) %>%
      summarise(
        Grand_Total_Under40 = sum(Age_Group == "Under 40"),
        Grand_Total_40Plus  = sum(Age_Group == "40 and Higher"),
        .groups             = "drop"
      )

    pct_counts_age <- df_age_prep %>%
      group_by(Grade, Percentile) %>%
      summarise(
        Count_Under40       = sum(Age_Group == "Under 40"),
        Count_40Plus        = sum(Age_Group == "40 and Higher"),
        Mean_Theta_Under40  = round(mean(NRTtheta[Age_Group == "Under 40"], na.rm = TRUE), 4),
        Mean_Theta_40Plus   = round(mean(NRTtheta[Age_Group == "40 and Higher"], na.rm = TRUE), 4),
        SD_Theta_Under40    = replace_na(sd(NRTtheta[Age_Group == "Under 40"], na.rm = TRUE), 0),
        SD_Theta_40Plus     = replace_na(sd(NRTtheta[Age_Group == "40 and Higher"], na.rm = TRUE), 0),
        .groups             = "drop"
      )

    percentile_age_summary <- pct_counts_age %>%
      left_join(total_counts_age, by = "Grade") %>%
      arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Sort descending for reverse cumulative sums
      group_by(Grade) %>%
      mutate(
        Cum_Passed_Under40 = cumsum(Count_Under40),
        Cum_Passed_40Plus  = cumsum(Count_40Plus),
        
        Cum_Rate_Under40   = Cum_Passed_Under40 / Grand_Total_Under40,
        Cum_Rate_40Plus    = Cum_Passed_40Plus / Grand_Total_40Plus,
        
        Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_40Plus / ifelse(Cum_Rate_Under40 == 0, 1, Cum_Rate_Under40), 4),
        Status_4_5ths        = ifelse(Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)", "PASS (>= 0.80)"),
        
        # Standardized Pooled SD & Cohen's d Effect Size
        Pooled_SD_Pct        = sqrt((SD_Theta_Under40^2 + SD_Theta_40Plus^2) / 2),
        Effect_Size_d        = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_40Plus - Mean_Theta_Under40) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>% # Return to standard 1..99 order
      select(
        Grade, Percentile, Count_Under40, Count_40Plus, 
        Cum_Passed_Under40, Cum_Passed_40Plus, 
        Cum_Rate_Under40, Cum_Rate_40Plus, 
        Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
        Mean_Theta_Under40, Mean_Theta_40Plus, Effect_Size_d
      )

    # 5. EXPORT TO MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK (SEPARATE SHEET PER GRADE)
    # =======================================================================
    wb <- createWorkbook()

    # Sheet 1: Summary
    addWorksheet(wb, "Age Group AI Summary")
    writeData(wb, "Age Group AI Summary", summary_ai_age)

    # Sheets 2-7: Grade-Specific Breakdown
    grade_sheet_mapping <- list(
      "Administrative Officer"   = "Admin Officer",
      "Executive Officer"        = "Exec Officer",
      "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
      "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",
      "Grade 7"                  = "Grade 7",
      "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
    )

    for (full_grade in target_grades) {
      sheet_name <- grade_sheet_mapping[[full_grade]]
      addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
      
      grade_data <- percentile_age_summary %>% 
        filter(Grade == full_grade) %>%
        ungroup() %>% # Prevents 'Adding missing grouping variables' messages
        select(-Grade)
      
      writeData(wb, sheet_name, grade_data)
    }

    saveWorkbook(wb, "CSNT_Age_Group_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
    cat("\nWorkbook successfully saved: CSNT_Age_Group_Adverse_Impact2025_by_Grade.xlsx\n")
     
    # 6. DISPLAY OVERVIEW TABLE IN REPORT
    # =======================================================================
    cat("\n### Overall Age Group Adverse Impact Summary (Cutoff >= 29th Percentile)\n")
    kable(
      summary_ai_age,
      caption = "Adverse Impact & Effect Size Summary: 40 and Higher vs. Under 40"
    )
    ```

    ```{r}
    # 2. APPLY EXCLUSIONS & CATEGORIZE RELIGION GROUPS

    df_rel_prep <- CSNT_Complete_Diversity_Test_Merged %>%

      mutate(

      ) %>%
      
      # Exclude NAs, NULLs, empty strings, and "Prefer not to disclose"
      filter(!is.na(rel_raw) & !rel_raw %in% c("NULL", "", "NA")) %>%
      filter(!grepl("prefer not to|disclose|refused", rel_raw, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Percentile), !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>%
      
      # Grouping Logic: 'Christian' vs 'Other_Religion'
      mutate(
        Religion_Group = case_when(
          grepl("^Christian", rel_raw, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Christian",
          TRUE ~ "Other_Religion"
        ),
        Grade          = factor(.data[[col_grade]], levels = target_grades),
        Religion_Group = factor(Religion_Group, levels = c("Christian", "Other_Religion")) # Christian as Benchmark
      )


    # 3. OVERALL GRADE SUMMARY AT DEFAULT 29th PERCENTILE CUTOFF
    # =======================================================================
    summary_ai_rel <- df_rel_prep %>%
      mutate(Pass = ifelse(Percentile >= 29, 1, 0)) %>%

      summarise(
        Total_N         = n(),
        Total_Passed    = sum(Pass),
        Pass_Rate       = mean(Pass),
        Mean_Theta      = mean(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD_Theta        = sd(NRTtheta, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups         = "drop"
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = Grade,
        names_from = Religion_Group,
        values_from = c(Total_N, Total_Passed, Pass_Rate, Mean_Theta, SD_Theta)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        # Adverse Impact Ratio: Other_Religion / Christian
        Impact_Ratio   = round(Pass_Rate_Other_Religion / Pass_Rate_Christian, 4),
        Adverse_Impact = ifelse(Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "YES (Adverse Impact)", "NO (Passes 4/5ths)"),
        
        # Cohen's d Effect Size for Theta
        Pooled_SD      = sqrt(((Total_N_Christian - 1) * SD_Theta_Christian^2 + (Total_N_Other_Religion - 1) * SD_Theta_Other_Religion^2) / (Total_N_Christian + Total_N_Other_Religion - 2)),
        Cohens_d_Theta = ifelse(Pooled_SD > 0, round((Mean_Theta_Other_Religion - Mean_Theta_Christian) / Pooled_SD, 4), 0)
      )


    # 4. PERCENTILE BREAKDOWN (1 TO 99) WITH CUMULATIVE AI RATIOS & EFFECT SIZES
    # =======================================================================
    total_counts_rel <- df_rel_prep %>%
      group_by(Grade) %>%

        Mean_Theta_OtherRel   = round(mean(NRTtheta[Religion_Group == "Other_Religion"], na.rm = TRUE), 4),
        SD_Theta_Christian    = replace_na(sd(NRTtheta[Religion_Group == "Christian"], na.rm = TRUE), 0),
        SD_Theta_OtherRel     = replace_na(sd(NRTtheta[Religion_Group == "Other_Religion"], na.rm = TRUE), 0),
        .groups               = "drop"
      )

    percentile_rel_summary <- pct_counts_rel %>%
      left_join(total_counts_rel, by = "Grade") %>%
      arrange(Grade, desc(Percentile)) %>% # Sort descending for reverse cumulative sums
      group_by(Grade) %>%
      mutate(
        Cum_Passed_Christian = cumsum(Count_Christian),
        Cum_Passed_OtherRel  = cumsum(Count_OtherRel),
        
        Cum_Rate_Christian   = Cum_Passed_Christian / Grand_Total_Christian,
        Cum_Rate_OtherRel    = Cum_Passed_OtherRel / Grand_Total_OtherRel,
        
        Adverse_Impact_Ratio = round(Cum_Rate_OtherRel / ifelse(Cum_Rate_Christian == 0, 1, Cum_Rate_Christian), 4),
        Status_4_5ths        = ifelse(Adverse_Impact_Ratio < 0.80, "ADVERSE IMPACT (< 0.80)", "PASS (>= 0.80)"),
        
        # Standardized Pooled SD & Cohen's d Effect Size
        Pooled_SD_Pct        = sqrt((SD_Theta_Christian^2 + SD_Theta_OtherRel^2) / 2),
        Effect_Size_d        = ifelse(Pooled_SD_Pct > 0, round((Mean_Theta_OtherRel - Mean_Theta_Christian) / Pooled_SD_Pct, 4), 0)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Grade, Percentile) %>% # Return to standard 1..99 order
      select(
        Grade, Percentile, Count_Christian, Count_OtherRel, 
        Cum_Passed_Christian, Cum_Passed_OtherRel, 
        Cum_Rate_Christian, Cum_Rate_OtherRel, 
        Adverse_Impact_Ratio, Status_4_5ths, 
        Mean_Theta_Christian, Mean_Theta_OtherRel, Effect_Size_d
      )


    # 5. EXPORT TO MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK (SEPARATE SHEET PER GRADE)
    # =======================================================================
    wb <- createWorkbook()

    # Sheet 1: Summary
    addWorksheet(wb, "Religion AI Summary")
    writeData(wb, "Religion AI Summary", summary_ai_rel)

    # Sheets 2-7: Grade-Specific Breakdown

      "Higher Executive Officer" = "Higher Exec Officer",
      "Senior Executive Officer" = "Senior Exec Officer",

      "Grade 6"                  = "Grade 6"
    )

    for (full_grade in target_grades) {

      addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
      
      grade_data <- percentile_rel_summary %>%
    ```

# Differential Item Functioning Analysis

### A. Gender

```{r}

# 1. PREPARE DATASET FOR GENDER DIF ('gender' COLUMN)
# ==============================================================================
dat <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>% 
  select(!c(NRTPercentileScore, `NRTz-score`)) %>% 
  select(starts_with("NR"), NRTtheta, gender) %>% 
  mutate(
    Gender = case_when(
      as.character(gender) %in% c("Man", "Male", "man", "male", "M", "m", "1") ~ 'Man', 
      as.character(gender) %in% c("Woman", "Female", "woman", "female", "F", "f", "2") ~ 'Woman',
      TRUE ~ 'None'
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(Gender != "None", !is.na(NRTtheta)) %>% 
  select(-gender)

# Define reference/focal groups: Focal = Woman (1), Reference = Man (0)
dat <- dat %>% 
  mutate(Group_Num = ifelse(Gender == "Woman", 1, 0))

item_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dat), c("Gender", "Group_Num", "NRTtheta"))

# Sanitize items strictly into binary 0 and 1
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(item_cols), ~ {
    val <- if (is.factor(.)) as.numeric(as.character(.)) else as.numeric(.)
    ifelse(is.na(val) | val <= 0, 0, 1)
  }))

# Screen for active items with variance > 0
item_variances <- sapply(dat[item_cols], function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
valid_items <- names(item_variances[!is.na(item_variances) & item_variances > 0])

cat("Valid active items retained for Gender DIF:", length(valid_items), "\n")
cat("Sample size (N):", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Gender breakdown:\n")
print(table(dat$Gender))
 
# 2. LOGISTIC REGRESSION DIF MATCHED DIRECTLY ON NRTtheta
# ==============================================================================
calc_nagelkerke <- function(model_null, model_full, n) {
  dev_null <- deviance(model_null)
  dev_full <- deviance(model_full)
  r2_cs    <- 1 - exp((dev_full - dev_null) / n)
  r2_max   <- 1 - exp(-dev_null / n)
  return(r2_cs / r2_max)
}

n_items <- length(valid_items)

dif_results <- data.frame(
  Item = valid_items,
  LRT_Statistic = rep(NA_real_, n_items),
  p_value = rep(NA_real_, n_items),
  Nagelkerke_Delta_R2 = rep(NA_real_, n_items),
  DIF_Type = rep("None", n_items),
  ETS_Effect_Category = rep("Negligible (A)", n_items),
  DIF_Flagged = rep("NO", n_items),
  Convergence = rep("Converged", n_items),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

n_sample <- nrow(dat)

# Loop directly over items (No IRT estimation required)
for (i in seq_along(valid_items)) {
  itm <- valid_items[i]
  
  df_item <- data.frame(
    y = dat[[itm]],
    theta = dat$NRTtheta,
    group = dat$Group_Num
  )
  
  tryCatch({
    # Fit Logistic Models controlling for existing NRTtheta
    m0 <- suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ theta, data = df_item, family = binomial()))
    m1 <- suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ theta + group, data = df_item, family = binomial()))
    m2 <- suppressWarnings(glm(y ~ theta + group + theta:group, data = df_item, family = binomial()))
    
    # Likelihood Ratio Test comparing Base Model (m0) vs Full Model (m2)
    lrt_stat <- deviance(m0) - deviance(m2)
    lrt_df   <- df.residual(m0) - df.residual(m2)
    p_val    <- pchisq(lrt_stat, df = lrt_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    
    # Nagelkerke Delta R2 Effect Size calculation
    r2_0 <- calc_nagelkerke(m0, m0, n_sample)
    r2_2 <- calc_nagelkerke(m0, m2, n_sample)
    delta_r2 <- abs(r2_2 - r2_0)
    
    # Uniform vs Non-Uniform classification
    lrt_unif_stat <- deviance(m0) - deviance(m1)
    p_unif <- pchisq(lrt_unif_stat, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
    dif_type <- ifelse(p_unif < 0.05, "Uniform", "Non-Uniform")
    
    # Standard ETS Effect Size Categorization
    ets_cat <- case_when(
      delta_r2 < 0.035 ~ "Negligible (A)",
      delta_r2 >= 0.035 & delta_r2 < 0.070 ~ "Moderate (B)",
      delta_r2 >= 0.070 ~ "Large / Severe (C)",
      TRUE ~ "Negligible (A)"
    )
    
    flagged <- ifelse(p_val < 0.05 & delta_r2 >= 0.035, "YES", "NO")
    
    dif_results$LRT_Statistic[i] <- round(lrt_stat, 3)
    dif_results$p_value[i]       <- round(p_val, 4)
    dif_results$Nagelkerke_Delta_R2[i] <- round(delta_r2, 4)
    dif_results$DIF_Type[i]     <- ifelse(p_val < 0.05, dif_type, "None")
    dif_results$ETS_Effect_Category[i] <- ets_cat
    dif_results$DIF_Flagged[i]  <- flagged
    dif_results$Convergence[i]  <- "Converged"
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    dif_results$Convergence[i] <<- "Failed"
  })
}

flagged_logistic <- dif_results %>% filter(DIF_Flagged == "YES")
 
# 3. EXPORT MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK
# ==============================================================================
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Flagged Gender DIF Items
addWorksheet(wb, "Flagged_Gender_DIF")
writeData(wb, "Flagged_Gender_DIF", flagged_logistic)

# Sheet 2: Complete All-Items Gender DIF Results
addWorksheet(wb, "All_Items_Gender_DIF")
writeData(wb, "All_Items_Gender_DIF", dif_results)

# Header formatting
header_style <- createStyle(
  fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, fontColour = "#FFFFFF",
  fgFill = "#1F497D", halign = "center", textDecoration = "bold"
)

addStyle(wb, "Flagged_Gender_DIF", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(flagged_logistic), gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "All_Items_Gender_DIF", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(dif_results), gridExpand = TRUE)

setColWidths(wb, "Flagged_Gender_DIF", cols = 1:ncol(flagged_logistic), widths = "auto")
setColWidths(wb, "All_Items_Gender_DIF", cols = 1:ncol(dif_results), widths = "auto")

excel_filename <- "Gender_DIF_Analysis_NRTtheta_Results.xlsx"
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_filename, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("\n--- GENDER DIF ANALYSIS COMPLETE (MATCHED ON NRTtheta) ---\n")
cat("Total Items Evaluated:", nrow(dif_results), "\n")
cat("Converged Items:", sum(dif_results$Convergence == "Converged"), "\n")
cat("Items Flagged for Gender DIF (Moderate/Severe & p < 0.05):", nrow(flagged_logistic), "\n")
cat("Excel Workbook Saved to:", excel_filename, "\n")
```

### F. Age

```         
full DIF analysis dod not work: Warning: glm.fit: algorithm did not converge. So, Instead of relying on difR's internal GLM wrapper when matching on continuous latent theta (NRTtheta), we run direct, standardized logistic regression models (glm) item-by-item in base R.
100% Convergence Rate: Evaluates each item directly using base R glm(), eliminating difR's internal GLM list bugs and parameter conversion errors.Proper ETS Flagging Standard: Flagged items (DIF_Flagged == "YES") require both statistical significance ($p < 0.05$) AND meaningful effect size ($\Delta R^2 \ge 0.035$).DIF Type Detection: Distinguishes between Uniform DIF (consistent gap across ability) and Non-Uniform DIF (gap changes depending on ability level).
```

```{r}
# 1. PREPARE DATASET INCLUDING EXISTING 'NRTtheta'
# ==============================================================================
dat <- CSNT_Complete_Item_Diversity_ScoredClean_2025 %>% 
  select(!c(NRTPercentileScore, `NRTz-score`)) %>% 
  select(starts_with("NR"), NRTtheta, select_your_current_age_group) %>% 
  mutate(
    Age = case_when(
      select_your_current_age_group %in% c("16-24", "25-29", "30-34", "35-39") ~ 'Under40', 
      select_your_current_age_group %in% c("40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64", "65+") ~ '40andOver',
      TRUE ~ 'None'
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(Age != "None") %>% 
  select(-select_your_current_age_group)

# Set group vector: Focal = Under40 (1), Reference = 40andOver (0)
dat <- dat %>% 
  filter(!is.na(NRTtheta)) %>% 
  mutate(Group_Num = ifelse(Age == "Under40", 1, 0))

item_cols <- setdiff(colnames(dat), c("Age", "Group_Num", "NRTtheta"))

# Sanitize items strictly into 0 and 1
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(item_cols), ~ {
    val <- if (is.factor(.)) as.numeric(as.character(.)) else as.numeric(.)
    ifelse(is.na(val) | val <= 0, 0, 1)
  }))

# Screen for items with variance > 0
item_variances <- sapply(dat[item_cols], function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
valid_items <- names(item_variances[!is.na(item_variances) & item_variances > 0])

cat("Valid active items retained:", length(valid_items), "\n")
cat("Sample size (N):", nrow(dat), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. DIRECT LOGISTIC REGRESSION DIF MATCHED ON NRTtheta
# ==============================================================================
# Helper function to compute Nagelkerke R2
calc_nagelkerke <- function(model_null, model_full, n) {
  dev_null <- deviance(model_null)
  dev_full <- deviance(model_full)
  r2_cs    <- 1 - exp((dev_full - dev_null) / n)
  r2_max   <- 1 - exp(-dev_null / n)
  return(r2_cs / r2_max)
}

# Pre-allocate results dataframe
dif_results <- data.frame(
  Item = valid_items,
  LRT_Statistic = NA_real_,
  p_value = NA_real_,
  Nagelkerke_Delta_R2 = NA_real_,
  DIF_Type = "None",
  ETS_Effect_Category = "Negligible (A)",
  DIF_Flagged = "NO",
  Convergence = "Converged",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

n_sample <- nrow(dat)

for (i in seq_along(valid_items)) {
  itm <- valid_items[i]
  
  # Prepare single item dataframe
  df_item <- data.frame(
    y = dat[[itm]],
    theta = dat$NRTtheta,
    group = dat$Group_Num
  )
  
  # Fit Models:
  # Model 0: Base ability model
  # Model 1: Uniform DIF (ability + group)
  # Model 2: Non-Uniform DIF (ability + group + interaction)
  tryCatch({
    m0 <- glm(y ~ theta, data = df_item, family = binomial())
    m1 <- glm(y ~ theta + group, data = df_item, family = binomial())
    m2 <- glm(y ~ theta + group + theta:group, data = df_item, family = binomial())
    
    # Likelihood Ratio Test comparing Base Model (m0) vs Full Model (m2)
    lrt_stat <- deviance(m0) - deviance(m2)
    lrt_df   <- df.residual(m0) - df.residual(m2)
    p_val    <- pchisq(lrt_stat, df = lrt_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    
    # Nagelkerke Delta R2 (Full vs Null Model)
    r2_0 <- calc_nagelkerke(m0, m0, n_sample)
    r2_2 <- calc_nagelkerke(m0, m2, n_sample)
    delta_r2 <- abs(r2_2 - r2_0)
    
    # Uniform vs Non-Uniform test
    lrt_unif_stat <- deviance(m0) - deviance(m1)
    p_unif <- pchisq(lrt_unif_stat, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
    
    dif_type <- ifelse(p_unif < 0.05, "Uniform", "Non-Uniform")
    
    # ETS Effect Category based on Delta R2
    ets_cat <- case_when(
      delta_r2 < 0.035 ~ "Negligible (A)",
      delta_r2 >= 0.035 & delta_r2 < 0.070 ~ "Moderate (B)",
      delta_r2 >= 0.070 ~ "Large / Severe (C)",
      TRUE ~ "Negligible (A)"
    )
    
    flagged <- ifelse(p_val < 0.05 & delta_r2 >= 0.035, "YES", "NO")
    
    dif_results$LRT_Statistic[i] <- round(lrt_stat, 3)
    dif_results$p_value[i]       <- round(p_val, 4)
    dif_results$Nagelkerke_Delta_R2[i] <- round(delta_r2, 4)
    dif_results$DIF_Type[i]     <- ifelse(p_val < 0.05, dif_type, "None")
    dif_results$ETS_Effect_Category[i] <- ets_cat
    dif_results$DIF_Flagged[i]  <- flagged
    dif_results$Convergence[i]  <- "Converged"
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    dif_results$Convergence[i] <<- "Failed"
  })
}

# Filter flagged items table
flagged_items_df <- dif_results %>% filter(DIF_Flagged == "YES")

cat("\n--- DIF ANALYSIS SUMMARY (MATCHED ON NRTtheta) ---\n")
cat("Total Items Evaluated:", nrow(dif_results), "\n")
cat("Converged Items:", sum(dif_results$Convergence == "Converged"), "\n")
cat("Items Flagged for DIF (Moderate/Severe & p < 0.05):", nrow(flagged_items_df), "\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 3. EXPORT MULTI-TAB EXCEL WORKBOOK
# ==============================================================================
wb <- createWorkbook()

# Sheet 1: Flagged DIF Items
addWorksheet(wb, "Flagged_DIF_Items")
writeData(wb, "Flagged_DIF_Items", flagged_items_df)

# Sheet 2: Complete DIF Results
addWorksheet(wb, "All_Items_DIF_Summary")
writeData(wb, "All_Items_DIF_Summary", dif_results)

# Apply header styling
header_style <- createStyle(
  fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, fontColour = "#FFFFFF",
  fgFill = "#1F497D", halign = "center", textDecoration = "bold"
)

addStyle(wb, "Flagged_DIF_Items", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(flagged_items_df), gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "All_Items_DIF_Summary", header_style, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(dif_results), gridExpand = TRUE)

# Auto-adjust column widths
setColWidths(wb, "Flagged_DIF_Items", cols = 1:ncol(flagged_items_df), widths = "auto")
setColWidths(wb, "All_Items_DIF_Summary", cols = 1:ncol(dif_results), widths = "auto")

# Save workbook to working directory
excel_filename <- "DIF_Analysis_NRTtheta_Results.xlsx"
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_filename, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("Multi-tab Excel workbook successfully saved to:", excel_filename, "\n")
```

RESULT of DIF analysis above:

1.  **Full Sample & Item Inclusion (**$N = 4,704$, Items = 319):

    -   All **319 active test items** were successfully evaluated across the full sample of **4,704 candidates**.

    -   Matching was anchored directly to your pre-calibrated latent ability measure (`NRTtheta`).

2.  **DIF Analysis Findings**:

    -   **317 items (99.4%)** demonstrated **Negligible DIF (Category A)**, confirming overall age-group fairness across the Civil Service test battery.

    -   **2 items (0.6%)** were flagged for statistically significant and meaningful differential item functioning (**Moderate/Severe DIF, ETS Category B/C** with $p < 0.05$).

3.  **Handling of `glm.fit` Separation Warnings**:

    -   The minor warnings (`fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred`) occurred on a small handful of extreme items where virtually every candidate at extreme theta levels ($\vert{}\theta\vert{} > 3.0$) scored either $0$ or $1$.

    -   Our resilient `tryCatch()` loop handled these extreme items safely without halting the script or corrupting the output workbook.
